# usrp

> Ettus USRP — the research-grade SDR family, B200/B210 and older USB models

**Vendor:** Ettus Research / National Instruments

Status: **supported** — the identifiers and setup recipe are believed correct.

**Not maintainer-verified**: nobody on this project has run this hardware yet. The two facts are recorded separately on purpose (D-027) — a correct recipe and a tested device are different claims.

## What it is

Ettus Research's Universal Software Radio Peripheral family. The B200 and B210 are the USB members and the ones most people meet; the entries here also cover the older USRP1 and B100, and the National-Instruments-branded B2xx boards, which enumerate under a different vendor id.

## What you can do with it

Full-duplex transmit and receive with calibration and clock discipline good enough for research work, driven through UHD directly or through GNU Radio and SoapySDR.

## Setup

Install uhd-host and join `plugdev`, then log out and back in. The FPGA images are large and Debian's package does not ship them all — `uhd_images_downloader` fetches what your board needs, over the network, on first use. `uhd_find_devices` should then list the board.

## Known problems

The firmware download on first use surprises people, especially on a field machine with no connectivity — fetch the images before you leave. USB 3.0 is effectively required for the B210's full sample rate, and a marginal cable or hub shows up as dropped samples rather than as an error. The NI-branded boards are the same hardware under a different vendor id, which is why both appear above.

## How it identifies itself

| USB id | What | Confirmed | Node |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fffe:0002` | USRP1 device — unknown vendor | yes | libusb |
| `2500:0002` | B100 device — Ettus Research LLC | yes | libusb |
| `2500:0020` | B200 — USRP B210, Ettus Research LLC | yes | libusb |
| `2500:0021` | USRP B200-mini — Ettus Research LLC | yes | libusb |
| `2500:0022` | B200 — USRP B205-mini, Ettus Research LLC | yes | libusb |
| `3923:7813` | B200 device — National Instruments Corp. | yes | libusb |
| `3923:7814` | B200 device — National Instruments Corp. | yes | libusb |

## Access and permissions

Group membership required: `plugdev` — added at install, applies at next login.
